pieces.name: Walnut River Desk
pieces.spec: Oregon black walnut · Black epoxy river · Welded steel base
pieces.description: Solid Oregon black walnut with a black epoxy river running through the natural live edge. Rich grain and coloring throughout, finished by hand to bring out the wood's character. The base is custom fabricated steel, hand welded, with threaded adjustable feet that level on any surface. Solid slab construction, no veneer or plywood. Works beautifully as a desk, a smaller dining table, or an entryway piece.

pieces.name: Oak Dining Table
pieces.spec: Solid oak slab · Blue epoxy fill · Steel X-frame base
pieces.description: A single solid oak slab with its natural cracks and checks filled in blue epoxy, left exactly where the tree made them. The top is finished by hand to bring out the grain and sits on a steel X-frame base, fabricated and finished in the shop. Solid slab construction, no veneer or plywood.

pieces.name: Elm Slab Coffee Table
pieces.spec: Live edge elm · Black epoxy seam · Steel sled base
pieces.description: A single elm slab with a natural live edge and a black epoxy seam running down the center. The edges are left raw so the slab keeps its history in plain view, every knot and burl exactly where the tree put it. The top is finished by hand to bring out the grain and sits on U-style steel sled legs, fabricated and finished in the shop.

pieces.name: Idaho Walnut Coffee Table
pieces.spec: Locally sourced walnut · Live edge · Steel sled base
pieces.description: Walnut sourced locally in Boise, Idaho, milled and finished by hand. The slab keeps its natural live edge and the deep chocolate figure walnut is known for. Set on U-style steel sled legs, fabricated and finished in the shop. Solid slab construction, no veneer or plywood.

pieces.name: Silver Maple Coffee Table
pieces.spec: Silver maple, live edge · Steel legs, darkened patina
pieces.description: Solid silver maple with a one of a kind live edge and natural grain throughout. Spalting and dark mineral lines run across the top, finished by hand to bring out the character of the wood. Set on tapered steel legs finished in a darkened patina under a satin clear coat, giving a raw, natural steel look that complements the wood. Threaded adjustable feet level the table on any surface.

pieces.name: Steel Frame Side Tables
pieces.spec: Walnut and honey locust tops · Welded steel frames · Set of two
pieces.description: A pair of side tables built around hand welded steel frames with an X brace on each face. One top is walnut, the other honey locust, each set flush into the steel. Fabricated and finished by hand in the shop.
